disease-modifying therapy. High efficacy: natalizumab, ocrelizumab, ofatumumab, ublituximab, rituximab, cladribine, alemtuzumab. Moderate efficacy: interferon beta, glatiramer, teriflunomide, fumarates, fingolimod and other S1P modulators
roles.note: growing consensus to start with a high-efficacy drug
